summary: Sony's hover-bike racing trilogy; use the 3Dfx-capable Windows port for the first game, the complete PlayStation standard edition for Jet Moto 2, and original PlayStation hardware or emulation for Jet Moto 3.

entries.title: Jet Moto

emulation.emulator: Windows compatibility wrapper / DuckStation for PlayStation fallback
emulation.notes: Use the PC port with 3Dfx support where possible; DuckStation is the clean fallback for the original PlayStation version.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: 3Dfx-enhanced PC rendering or high-resolution PlayStation emulation

primary.version: North American Windows port with 3Dfx acceleration
primary.why: The Windows version adds 3Dfx hardware acceleration with higher-resolution rendering and visual enhancements such as reflective water while preserving the original game's course and race structure.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version on a compatible PC/VM or preservation wrapper with 3Dfx support; use the PlayStation version or PSN release only for original console feel.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PSN release is a re-release of the PlayStation version, not a remaster.

entries.title: Jet Moto 2

emulation.notes: Use internal-resolution scaling on the standard PlayStation release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-resolution PlayStation emulation; Championship Edition can be sampled for its faster variant

primary.why: The standard PlayStation release keeps the full 10-racer format. The later Championship Edition runs at a higher frame rate but reduces the race field to four competitors, so it is a fidelity tradeoff rather than the best complete playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Play the standard PlayStation release on original hardware or DuckStation with internal-resolution scaling; sample the Championship Edition only to compare its 30 fps/four-racer variant.

entries.remaster_caveats: Championship Edition is a variant, not a remaster; PSN is a downloadable re-release.

entries.title: Jet Moto 3

emulation.notes: Internal-resolution scaling is the clean fidelity route for the PlayStation original.

primary.why: Jet Moto 3 is a PlayStation release with no sourced PC or modern remaster; the PSN release was removed shortly after release, making the original disc/emulation path the dependable preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release on original hardware or DuckStation with internal-resolution scaling; use any already-owned PSN copy only as a convenience path.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster exists; the PSN release was delisted shortly after release.
